classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding lengths in oppositely oriented survey triangles to calculate an inaccessible width.

content.prompt:
A deep chasm has a large rock sitting on its side.
Four pegs are placed on the other side using the rock as a reference point.
Find the width of the chasm.

spec.description: Two parallel banks, a rock on the upper bank and four pegs on or below the lower bank. The lower peg, middle bank peg and rock are collinear. Oppositely oriented triangles share that diagonal.
spec.mathematics: The small triangle has horizontal length 2 m and vertical length 1.8 m. The corresponding large horizontal length is 8 m; the vertical rock-to-right-peg distance is unknown.
spec.answerVisibility: All measurements and reference points are permanent givens. The chasm width is omitted.
